responsibility: Declares Android-related Linux target options: the target switch -mandroid controlling the ANDROID mask and the internal driver selectors tno-android-cc and tno-android-ld used by specs to suppress Android behavior for individual tool invocations. It is option metadata for the Linux/Android split, not the implementation of Android specs themselves.
same_name_distinction: Within the linux-android same-name pair, this file is only the option table for selecting Android behavior and for internal spec-control switches; linux-android.h contains the actual Android-versus-Linux spec logic, builtins, and crt/linker selections.
